topic: HSA triple tax break for open enrollment
hook: On a high-deductible plan? Open an HSA.

blocks.narration: On a high-deductible plan? Open an HSA. Money goes in tax-free, grows tax-free, and comes out tax-free for medical bills. For 2027, you can save up to nine thousand dollars.
blocks.visual: Paper-cutout first-aid kit shaped like a piggy bank on cream paper; coins drop in, a small green sprout grows from the coins, then coins flow out into a paper pharmacy bag, each step stamped with a green check mark; ends on a tall coin stack with paper confetti

cta: Follow for one money rule a day.
visual_style: clean editorial collage, warm paper textures, bold numbers, green and cream palette

captions.hook_line: Open enrollment tip: the account with a triple tax break 💚
captions.body: On an HSA-eligible high-deductible health plan? Contributions go in pre-tax, grow tax-free, and come out tax-free for qualified medical expenses. 2027 limits: $4,500 self-only, $9,000 family.

youtube_title: HSA: The Triple Tax Break Most People Skip
